description: Work on a Convexity model FILE: absolute path to a .db on disk. All subsequent tools operate on it, and edits are written in place — suggest the user works on a copy of any model they care about. A model that lives in the Convexity app is opened with open_in_app instead. Resets the active scenario to the base case. A file older than schema 4.0 is not opened in place: pass upgrade_copy: true to write a converted copy beside it and open that.

upgrade_copy.description: For a pre-4.0 file: write <name>-4.1.db beside it (the original is not touched) and open the copy.

name: open_model
